title: JPY price amendment ('Amendment 1'); small change in USD terms
subject: KT-0612 Amendment 1 (price)
body:
Dear Karthik-san,

After our cotton price review we accept your request: the unit price for KT-0612 is revised to JPY 1,240. Amendment 1 is attached. All other terms are unchanged.

Best regards,
Haruka Mori
Kumo Textile Co., Ltd.
